reason: Provides agent-facing browser access for retrieving rendered public webpages and exporting them as markdown, screenshots, or PDFs through Cloudflare Browser Rendering.

summaries.zh: 通过 Cloudflare Browser Rendering 为智能体提供可执行 JavaScript 的网页浏览，并将页面导出为 Markdown、PNG 截图或 PDF。
summaries.en: Provides agent-facing browser access through Cloudflare Browser Rendering to retrieve JavaScript-enabled pages and export them as Markdown, PNG screenshots, or PDFs.

capabilities: Fetches public web pages through Cloudflare Browser Rendering
Produces markdown, PNG screenshots, and PDF files
Supports authenticated browser sessions and WebMCP sites
Uses Cloudflare API credentials supplied in configuration
